brief:
Twenty Gaza students will travel to Ireland to pursue scholarships following a successful visa appeal, the Guardian reported. The group's evacuation comes after a campaign that overturned an initial Irish government decision to deny visas to more than 60 students from the territory.

Details of the students' scholarships and their fields of study were not disclosed in the available reporting.

title: Twenty Gaza students win Irish visas after campaign reversal
